concerns.text: T002 writes the final QC artifacts (subjects_metadata.json, qc_report.json with retained/excluded counts and retention rate) and enforces the N>=10 halt (101897696), but T003 later excludes additional subjects for missing conditions/zero-variance ROIs (FR-011/FR-014) without updating those artifacts or re-checking N>=10. A cohort that passes T002 with N=10 can drop below 10 after T003 exclusions, and downstream consumers (T004 cohort table, SC-001 retention rate, T010 report) read stale T002 counts. Add a post-T003 cohort-finalization step (update qc_report/subjects_metadata and re-assert N>=10) or move the FR-011/FR-014 exclusion accounting into T002's outputs.
